meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: How Happy Paws Cat Rescue collects, uses and protects your information.

s1.p: How Happy Paws Cat Rescue collects and looks after your personal information.

draft: **Draft for Happy Paws to approve.** This was written by the website’s designers from how the website works. It is not legal advice. Please read every line, correct anything that is wrong, and take advice if you are unsure. Delete this box when the policy is approved.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body:
Happy Paws Cat Rescue is a registered charity in England and Wales (charity number 1220228). We rescue cats and find them new homes, from Stockton, Birmingham and Banbury. We decide how your personal information is used, which makes us the “data controller” under UK data protection law.

If you have a question about this policy, or about your information, email [info@happypawscatrescue.org](mailto:info@happypawscatrescue.org).

sections.title: What information we collect
sections.body:
### If you apply to adopt or foster

The application forms are provided by Pawlytics, the system we use to look after our cats and applications. They appear inside our website, but the forms themselves are hosted for Pawlytics by a company called Airtable. We receive what you type into the form. We may also ask you for more at a home check.

### If you use the contact form

We collect your first and last name, your email address, your phone number if you give one, the topic you chose, the name of a cat if you give one, and your message. We also record whether you ticked the box to receive our newsletter.

### If you sign up for the newsletter

We collect your email address.

### If you give us a donation

Card payments are taken on Stripe’s own secure pages. We never see or keep your card number. Stripe tells us your name, your email address, how much you gave and whether the gift is monthly or one-off, plus anything else Stripe asks you for on its payment page.

### When you visit the website

We do not use analytics or advertising trackers on this website. Our website host, Netlify, may keep routine technical records, such as your IP address and the pages requested, to keep the site running and secure.

### About our cats

The cat pages show details of the cat only. They do not show the names or addresses of foster carers or adopters.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body:
- **To consider applications** to adopt or foster, to arrange home checks, and to match cats with the right people. We do this because it is necessary to look after the cats safely, and because you ask us to when you apply.
- **To reply to your messages.** We do this because you asked us a question.
- **To send our newsletter,** but only if you asked for it. You can stop it at any time.
- **To record donations,** send receipts and keep the charity’s accounts. We do this because the law requires charities to keep financial records.
- **To keep the website working and secure.**

We do not sell your information. We do not use it to make decisions by computer without a person being involved.

sections.title: Who we share it with
sections.body:
We use these services to run the charity. Each one receives only what it needs.

- **Pawlytics** provides the adoption and foster forms, and holds the applications and our cat records. Its forms are hosted by Airtable.
- **Stripe** takes donations. It handles your card details under its own privacy policy.
- **Netlify** hosts this website. It receives contact form and newsletter messages, stores them for us, and emails contact messages to our address above.
- **Our email provider** runs our email address, so it handles messages you send us.

We may also share information if the law requires it, or to protect a cat or a person from harm.

Some of these services are based outside the UK, mainly in the USA.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body:
We keep your information only for as long as we need it for the reasons above, and for as long as the law requires us to keep financial records.

- Newsletter sign-ups: until you unsubscribe.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body:
You can ask us to show you the information we hold about you, to correct it, to delete it, to limit how we use it, to stop using it, or to give you a copy you can take elsewhere. If we use your information because you agreed, you can take that agreement back at any time. To do any of these, email us. We will reply within one month.

If you are not happy with how we have used your information, you can complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office at [ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint](https://ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint/). We would like the chance to put it right first.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body:
This website does not set cookies of its own, and it has no analytics or advertising cookies.

Some parts of the journey are run by other companies, and they may set their own cookies: the application forms (Airtable, for Pawlytics) on the adoption and foster application pages, and Stripe’s payment pages, where Stripe uses cookies to keep payments secure.

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Some forms and payment pages may not work if you do.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We will update this page if how we use your information changes, and the date at the top shows when it last changed.
